origin: LTspice schematics by the maintainer, LTspice 26.1.1's -netlist exports of them, and variants of the exports made for M14, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported by LTspice 26.1.1 with -netlist; the first comment line holds the absolute schematic path in the export and is replaced by the file name. A variant's second line says what it changes. The intentional failures are in elements_rejects. M15 added B and the nonlinear forms, with variants written from these files; the files of M15b's forms are skipped by the solver sweep until then. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-06.

.gitignore.note: Keeps LTspice run output out, as in ltspice_transistors (decision 0009).
